title: The aunt
html_source: Referred to again soon after, this is Malachi’s wealthy and pious Aunt Ursula who disapproves of Stephen. Some researchers have identified this unseen character with Oliver St. John Gogarty’s real life aunt, Anne “Annie” Henry Oliver. Annie occasionally lived in the home of her sister Margaret Gogarty (née Oliver) and Margaret’s children, including Oliver St. John, after Margaret’s husband Henry died in 1891. She seemed to have played a role in managing the household and raising Margaret’s children, which matches the descriptions in this chapter of Mulligan’s aunt hiring the servants in his house, lending him money, and lecturing Mulligan about his company.
